meditacion-diaria.title: Meditate for 10 minutes
meditacion-diaria.details: Set aside a quiet moment each morning to breathe and begin the day with a clearer mind.

caminar-cinco-km.title: Walk 5 km
caminar-cinco-km.details: Take a brisk walk to build stamina and clear your mind.
caminar-cinco-km.configurationSummary: Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays · afternoon · 36 walks

leer-libros.title: Read 20 pages
leer-libros.details: Make progress in a book each night and replace a little screen time with reading.

entrenamiento-fuerza.title: Strength train for 45 minutes
entrenamiento-fuerza.details: Complete a full strength session with a warm-up, main exercises, and a cool-down.
entrenamiento-fuerza.configurationSummary: Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays · 6:30 PM · 24 workouts

ahorro-mensual.title: Save €100 each month
ahorro-mensual.details: Set the money aside at the start of the month and keep it separate from everyday spending.

llamar-familia.title: Call my family
llamar-familia.details: Make time for an unhurried conversation to catch up and nurture the relationships that matter.

beber-agua.title: Drink 8 glasses of water
beber-agua.details: At the end of the day, record whether you stayed well hydrated by drinking regularly throughout the day.

ordenar-casa.title: Declutter one area at home
ordenar-casa.details: Choose a drawer, cupboard, or corner, remove what you no longer need, and organize it in a way that is easy to maintain.

estudiar-idioma.title: Study a language for 30 minutes
estudiar-idioma.details: Combine vocabulary, comprehension, and speaking practice in a short but consistent session.
estudiar-idioma.configurationSummary: Monday through Friday · 8:00 PM · for 3 months

escritura-creativa.title: Write 500 words
escritura-creativa.details: Draft without editing so you can make steady progress on a story, journal, or personal project.

desconexion-digital.title: Stay off my phone for 2 hours
desconexion-digital.details: Leave your phone out of reach and enjoy one afternoon each week without social media or notifications.

revisiones-preventivas.title: Complete my preventive health checkups
revisiones-preventivas.details: Plan three milestones: book the appointment, attend the checkup, and review or file the results.

pausa-visual.title: Rest my eyes for 20 seconds
pausa-visual.details: Look away from the screen and focus on something in the distance to ease eye strain during an intensive workday.

pausa-activa.title: Take a 5-minute movement break
pausa-activa.details: Stand up, loosen your shoulders and hips, and walk around briefly to break up long periods of sitting.

revision-semanal.title: Do a weekly review
revision-semanal.details: Review your commitments, celebrate progress, close open loops, and choose your top three priorities for the coming week.

salida-naturaleza.title: Spend 90 minutes in nature
salida-naturaleza.details: Visit a park, forest, or other natural setting, walk at an easy pace, and pay mindful attention to your surroundings.

limpieza-digital-mensual.title: Organize 50 digital files
limpieza-digital-mensual.details: Delete duplicates, archive useful documents, and clear your downloads folder to keep your digital space manageable.

chequeo-anual.title: Get an annual preventive checkup
chequeo-anual.details: Ask a healthcare professional which screenings suit your age and medical history, then follow up on the results.

diario-gratitud.title: Write down 3 things I am grateful for
diario-gratitud.details: Note specific experiences, people, or small positive moments to develop a more balanced view of your day.
diario-gratitud.configurationSummary: Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays · evening · for 8 weeks

luz-natural.title: Get 15 minutes of natural light
luz-natural.details: Go outside early in the day to support your circadian rhythm, daytime alertness, and nighttime sleep.

planificar-comidas.title: Plan 5 healthy meals
planificar-comidas.details: Choose simple dishes, check the ingredients you already have, and prepare a shopping list to reduce impulse choices.

yoga-matutino.title: Practice yoga for 25 minutes
yoga-matutino.details: Combine mobility, breathing, and foundational poses to begin the day with an active body and a focused mind.
yoga-matutino.configurationSummary: Tuesdays and Thursdays · 7:00 AM · for 8 weeks

trabajo-profundo.title: Complete 90 minutes of deep work
trabajo-profundo.details: Work on one important priority with notifications off, a clearly defined task, and no context switching.

cocinar-cenas-saludables.title: Cook a healthy dinner
cocinar-cenas-saludables.details: Prepare a dinner based on minimally processed foods, with vegetables, protein, and a sensible portion size.
cocinar-cenas-saludables.configurationSummary: Mondays, Wednesdays, and Sundays · evening · 24 dinners

rutina-sueno.title: Complete a 30-minute bedtime routine
rutina-sueno.details: Dim the lights, put screens away, prepare for the next day, and do something calming before bed.

reflexion-terapeutica.title: Complete 4 guided reflection sessions
reflexion-terapeutica.details: Use each session to identify patterns, prepare questions, record insights, and choose one practical next step.

revision-valores.title: Review my values and priorities
revision-valores.details: Write about what matters now, what is receiving your time, and one concrete adjustment you want to make.
revision-valores.configurationSummary: 4 specific dates · evening · in 1, 3, 6, and 12 months

aprendizaje-primeros-auxilios.title: Complete a first aid course
aprendizaje-primeros-auxilios.details: Break the course into four milestones: core theory, practical skills, emergency review, and final assessment.
aprendizaje-primeros-auxilios.configurationSummary: 4 specific dates · any time · over 2 months

acto-amabilidad.title: Perform one intentional act of kindness
acto-amabilidad.details: Offer help, express specific appreciation, or give someone your full attention without expecting anything in return.
acto-amabilidad.configurationSummary: Tuesdays and Fridays · afternoon · for 10 weeks

voluntariado.title: Give 2 hours to a cause
voluntariado.details: Contribute regularly to a local initiative that aligns with your values and your community's needs.
